items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: We formed a band in, in, uh, Kansas City, Missouri... It was our Envoy Doon

ctx.x: Yeah. And, uh, we had a 32, I think it was a 32 piece band. We formed a band in, in, uh, Kansas City, Missouri. And we went to Hoboken, New Jersey. We went over in, uh, England. See? We crossed the English Channel and went over in France. It was our Envoy Doon, Le Havre, and Paris, France, you know. Oh yeah. Then, uh, the band broke up, you know, after the war was over.
All of those pictures you showed us the other night.
